scope: safe integration checks; no app sources, packaged model binaries, or Gradle files changed

pristine_cpu_smoke.position_128: EXPECTED_FAIL Gather index out of bounds; confirms learned position table limit

derived_stage_row_equivalence.metric: max abs diff against derived independent rows

limitations: The protocol gates compare pristine versus derived graphs under each protocol; they do not decide whether the current Kotlin off-by-one behavior should migrate to the corrected protocol.
Fixtures are synthetic; no .studio/ocr.json crop comparison, full-chapter, Android provider, RSS, thermal, or OCR-quality gate was run.
derived_batch_gate.follow_up: Run the protocol comparison on the available .studio/ocr.json corpus, then repeat batching on Android with real crops and device memory/thermal gates.

openvino.observed: Intel CPU/GPU OpenVINO compilation and isolated inference succeeded; Intel NPU compile failed with unrecognized device ID; AUTO selected CPU.
openvino.not_a_pipeline_result: The recorded hybrid function uses independent random inputs for encoder, decoder_init, and decoder_step; it does not chain hidden states or update KV caches.
openvino.chained_followup: CPU chain matched ORT tokens/logits on 2/2 synthetic fixtures; GPU chain matched tokens but failed the strict logit gate (max abs about 0.13–0.15) and was slower; AUTO was explicit CPU fallback.

precision.evidence: FP16 matched greedy tokens on 8/8 bounded fixtures (2 real) but was not faster on CPU; both tested INT8 variants had 0/8 exact sequences and large drift.

remaining_blockers: Current Kotlin versus corrected lab decoder protocol golden comparison on real .studio crops
Snapdragon strict QNN/HTP session creation and real inference with CPU fallback disabled
Android memory, thermal, reader-latency, and provider-partition measurements
